removed: Removed “{{label}}” from this responsibility. It still exists, and stays under any other responsibility it is filed under.
unlinkFailed: Couldn’t remove it from this responsibility.
deleteDescription: This removes the responsibility, its bar and its number. The projects, tasks and routines filed under it stay. To stop owning it but keep its history, let it go instead.
notAvailableHint: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to someone else.
otherOrganization: This responsibility belongs to another organization
